cards.ex: The architect showed us the layout plan for the new shopping mall.
cards.exUz: Arxitektor bizga yangi savdo markazining reja tuzilishini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Bino yoki hududning qanday joylashishini ko'rsatuvchi chizma.

cards.ex: Urban sprawl is causing problems with traffic and pollution.
cards.exUz: Shahar kengayishi transport va ifloslanish bilan bog'liq muammolarni keltirib chiqarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning tartibsiz ravishda chekka hududlarga o'sishi.

cards.ex: The city needs more green space for people to relax.
cards.exUz: Shaharga odamlar dam olishi uchun ko'proq yashil hudud kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shaharda daraxtlar, o'tloqlar va bog'lar kabi ochiq joylar.

cards.ex: The high-rise building offers stunning views of the city.
cards.exUz: Ko'p qavatli bino shaharning ajoyib manzaralarini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda baland bo'lgan bino, odatda ko'p qavatli.

cards.ex: Historic preservation is important for maintaining our cultural heritage.
cards.exUz: Tarixiy muhofaza madaniy merosimizni saqlash uchun muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy binolar va joylarni saqlash va tiklash.

cards.ex: Sustainable design focuses on energy efficiency and using recycled materials.
cards.exUz: Barqaror dizayn energiya samaradorligiga va qayta ishlangan materiallardan foydalanishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga kamroq zarar yetkazadigan dizayn uslubi.

cards.ex: The new building code requires all buildings to be earthquake-resistant.
cards.exUz: Yangi qurilish qoidalari barcha binolarni zilzilaga chidamli bo'lishini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qurilish va xavfsizlik standartlarini belgilaydigan qoidalar.

cards.ex: Zoning regulations prevent factories from being built in residential areas.
cards.exUz: Hududiy qoidalar zavodlarning turar-joy hududlarida qurilishiga yo'l qo'ymaydi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning qaysi qismlarida qanday binolar qurilishini belgilaydigan qoidalar.

cards.ex: They're working on a renovation project to restore the old theater.
cards.exUz: Ular eski teatrni tiklash uchun ta'mirlash loyihasida ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Eski binoni yangilash yoki yaxshilash ishlari.

cards.ex: We have several new construction projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir nechta yangi qurilish loyihalari jarayonda.
cards.uzDef: Hali amalga oshirilmagan, lekin rejalashtirilgan yoki ish boshlangan.

cards.ex: The architect needs to draw up plans for the new museum.
cards.exUz: Arxitektor yangi muzey uchun reja tuzishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qurilish yoki boshqa ishlar uchun batafsil reja yaratish.

cards.ex: The engineers are studying the blueprint to understand the building's structure.
cards.exUz: Muhandislar binoning tuzilishini tushunish uchun ko'k nusxani o'rganishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bino yoki mashinaning texnik chizmasi.

cards.ex: The new store is located in an area with high foot traffic.
cards.exUz: Yangi do'kon odamlar oqimi yuqori bo'lgan hududda joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir joydan o'tadigan odamlar soni.

cards.ex: That abandoned building is a real eye-sore in the neighborhood.
cards.exUz: U tashlandiq bino mahallada haqiqiy ko'zni qamashtiruvchi narsa.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli ko'rinmaydigan narsa, ko'rinishi yomon narsa.

cards.ex: The city is investing in urban renewal to revitalize the downtown area.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazini jonlantirish uchun shaharni yangilashga sarmoya kiritmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning eski va yomon qismlarini yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The park is a popular public space for families and friends to gather.
cards.exUz: Park oilalar va do'stlar yig'ilishi uchun mashhur jamoat joyi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma foydalanishi mumkin bo'lgan joy, masalan, park yoki maydon.

cards.ex: I really like the layout of your apartment; it feels very spacious.
cards.exUz: Sizning kvartirangizning joylashuvi menga juda yoqdi; u juda keng ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Narsalarning qanday joylashtirilganligi yoki tashkil etilganligi.

cards.ex: The new landscaping really improved the appearance of the office building.
cards.exUz: Yangi obodonlashtirish ofis binosining ko'rinishini sezilarli darajada yaxshiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hududni chiroyli qilish uchun daraxtlar va o'simliklar ekish.

cards.ex: The new mixed-use development will bring more jobs and housing to the area.
cards.exUz: Yangi aralash foydalanish loyihasi hududga ko'proq ish o'rinlari va uy-joy olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy, do'konlar va ofislar bir joyda bo'lgan loyiha.

cards.ex: The government is investing in improving the country's infrastructure.
cards.exUz: Hukumat mamlakat infratuzilmasini yaxshilashga sarmoya kiritmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakat yoki hududning asosiy tizimlari, masalan, yo'llar va suv ta'minoti.

cards.ex: Traffic congestion is a major problem in the city during rush hour.
cards.exUz: Transport tiqilishi shaharda eng gavjum paytlarda katta muammo.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lda transport vositalarining sekin harakatlanishi yoki to'xtab qolishi.

cards.ex: The city center has a large pedestrian zone with shops and restaurants.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazida do'konlar va restoranlar bilan katta piyodalar zonasi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Faqat piyodalar yurishi mumkin bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: The city is working to redevelop brownfield sites into parks and housing.
cards.exUz: Shahar tashlandiq sanoat hududlarini parklar va uy-joylarga aylantirish ustida ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ilgari sanoat maqsadlarida ishlatilgan va ifloslangan hudud.

cards.ex: The population density is very high in the city center.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazida aholi zichligi juda yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir maydonda yashovchi odamlar soni.

cards.ex: Adaptive reuse is a great way to preserve historic buildings and create new spaces.
cards.exUz: Moslashuvchan qayta foydalanish tarixiy binolarni saqlash va yangi joylar yaratishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Eski binoni yangi maqsadlarda ishlatish.

cards.ex: The new construction project finally got the go-ahead from the city council.
cards.exUz: Yangi qurilish loyihasi nihoyat shahar kengashidan ruxsat oldi.
cards.uzDef: Loyiha yoki taklif uchun rasmiy ruxsat olish.

cards.ex: You'll need planning permission before you can build an extension on your house.
cards.exUz: Uyingizga qo'shimcha qurishdan oldin sizga rejalashtirish ruxsati kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi bino qurish yoki o'zgartirish uchun hukumatdan olinadigan ruxsat.

cards.ex: The new park is just a stone's throw away from my house.
cards.exUz: Yangi park mening uyimdan juda yaqin joyda.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofada, qo'l yetadigan joyda.

cards.ex: The architect is known for their cutting-edge design and innovative ideas.
cards.exUz: Arxitektor o'zining zamonaviy dizayni va innovatsion g'oyalari bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Eng so'nggi texnologiyalar va uslublardan foydalanadigan dizayn.

cards.ex: That dilapidated building is a real eyesore in the neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Ushbu xarob bino mahallada haqiqiy xunuk joy.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rinishi yoqimsiz bo'lgan, estetik zavq bermaydigan joy.
